35:   // Misc Logic - renamed 'reset' to 'reset_wire' to avoid conflict with Chisel's built-in reset

46:   i_tx_phy.io.fs_ce := fs_ce

50:   io.TxReady_o := i_tx_phy.io.TxReady_o

52:   // Connect TX Phy outputs to main module outputs
53:   io.txdp := i_tx_phy.io.txdp
54:   io.txdn := i_tx_phy.io.txdn
55:   io.txoe := i_tx_phy.io.txoe
56:   
57:   // RX Phy instantiation
58:   val i_rx_phy = Module(new usb_rx_phy())
59:   i_rx_phy.io.clk := clock
60:   i_rx_phy.io.rst := reset_wire
61:   i_rx_phy.io.fs_ce := fs_ce
62:   i_rx_phy.io.rxd := io.rxd
63:   i_rx_phy.io.rxdp := io.rxdp
64:   i_rx_phy.io.rxdn := io.rxdn
65:   i_rx_phy.io.RxEn_i := io.txoe
66:   io.DataIn_o := i_rx_phy.io.DataIn_o
67:   io.RxValid_o := i_rx_phy.io.RxValid_o
68:   io.RxActive_o := i_rx_phy.io.RxActive_o
69:   io.RxError_o := i_rx_phy.io.RxError_o
70:   io.LineState_o := i_rx_phy.io.LineState
71:   
72:   // USB Reset generation logic
73:   when(!io.rst) {
74:     rst_cnt := 0.U
75:   }.elsewhen(io.LineState_o =/= 0.U) {
76:     rst_cnt := 0.U
77:   }.elsewhen(!usb_rst_reg && fs_ce) {
78:     rst_cnt := rst_cnt + 1.U
79:   }
80:   
81:   usb_rst_reg := (rst_cnt === 31.U)
82:   io.usb_rst := usb_rst_reg
